summary: Completed comprehensive testing of KN-G6-ICA-CLOBBER fix (inter-company accounts directional fix). All backend APIs and frontend UI verified working correctly with new directional account structure.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/interco/accounts - All new fields present (id with _ar/_ap suffix, role, pair_key, seller/buyer entity fields)
Backend: CRITICAL bidirectional trade test - Original debt Rp 1,766,010 preserved after reverse transaction
Backend: GET /api/interco/accounts/{from}/{to}?role= - Role filtering works, invalid role rejected
Backend: GET /api/interco/reminders - Correct structure with rows, overdue, checked
Backend: POST /api/interco/accounts/{payer}/{payee}/remind - Reminder sent, dedupe works, zero balance rejected
Backend: RBAC - sales@ correctly gets 403 on returns endpoints
Backend: Regression - All other interco endpoints work (transactions, settlements, returns, margin-report)
Frontend: Successfully navigated to 'Saldo Antar-PT' tab
Frontend: Table interco-accounts-table exists with all required columns
Frontend: 'Dasar dagang' column shows correct format (PT penjual menjual ke PT pembeli)
Frontend: Debt amount Rp 1,766,010 displayed correctly
Frontend: 'Ingatkan' and 'Buat Settlement' buttons exist and are clickable
Frontend: All other tabs render without errors (Daftar Transaksi, Settlement, Retur Antar-PT, Pinjaman Antar-PT, Rapor Margin)

core_fix_verified.issue: KN-G6-ICA-CLOBBER - Inter-company account IDs were ica_{X}_{Y} WITHOUT role indicator, causing receivables A→B and payables B→A to share ONE document. When two entities traded BOTH DIRECTIONS, the second recompute OVERWROTE the first, causing debt of Rp 1,766,010 to DISAPPEAR.
core_fix_verified.fix_applied: IDs now include trade direction + role: ica_{seller}_{buyer}_ar and ica_{buyer}_{seller}_ap. New fields: pair_key, seller_entity_id/name, buyer_entity_id/name. get_account(from,to,role) now requires role.
core_fix_verified.verification: Created reverse direction transaction (ent_kanda → ent_ksc) and cancelled it. Original debt (ent_kanda owes ent_ksc Rp 1,766,010) was PRESERVED. Reverse direction has its own 2 rows. No duplicate (role, pair_key) combinations found.

ui_enhancements_verified: New column 'Dasar dagang' displays trade direction in Indonesian: '{PT penjual} menjual ke {PT pembeli}'
All columns present: Dari, Ke, Jenis, Dasar dagang, Bruto, Terlunasi, Diretur, Sisa, Umur, Aksi
Debt row with Rp 1,766,010 displays correctly
Action buttons 'Ingatkan' and 'Buat Settlement' are present and functional
no_regressions: All frontend tabs render without errors
